description: PreToolUse Bash -> rtk-rewrite.mjs: a router — read-only gather commands (bare curl/wget GETs, >=3-segment text-tool chains, >=3-stage text pipelines) are deny-steered to context-mode's ctx_fetch_and_index / ctx_batch_execute / ctx_execute with a copy-ready replacement call (steer_enabled toggle); everything else is rewritten to its rtk equivalent using the bundled rtk binary (auto_rewrite toggle). PreToolUse WebFetch -> webfetch-steer.mjs: deny-steers every WebFetch to ctx_fetch_and_index + ctx_search (steer_enabled toggle). SessionStart -> server.mjs --session-start-hook (command hook: mcp_tool hard-errors pre-connect), SubagentStart -> hook_subagent_context, PreToolUse Grep|Glob -> hook_symbol_context, PostToolUse Read -> hook_coverage_context: fail-open, context-only codebase-memory-mcp graph context served as mcp_tool hooks by this plugin's own codebase-memory proxy MCP server (mcp/server.mjs). Second SessionStart entry -> cat hooks/SessionStart.md: injects the context-mode MCP server's own routing-rules document (upstream, verbatim) as session context on every startup/resume/clear/compact. Second SubagentStart entry -> cat hooks/subagent-nudge.md: static additionalContext telling subagents to skip inter-tool-call narration and to prefer context-mode's ctx_* tools. Eight hooks total.
